title: push-images workflow: tests/test_push_images_workflow.py pins the YAML structure, so edits must update its assertions
answers: How do I test changes to the Docker image publish workflow locally?
Why does my edit to push-images.yml fail a pytest test?
Which test checks that floating image tags are promoted after versioned images are pushed?
Where are the workflow ordering and permissions checks for the release image job?
body:
Path: tests/test_push_images_workflow.py, function test_floating_image_tags_are_promoted_after_versioned_images_are_published, parses .github/workflows/push-images.yml with yaml.safe_load and asserts job order, step indexes, permissions and concurrency.
Rule: Run `UV_FROZEN=1 uv run pytest tests/test_push_images_workflow.py` after editing push-images.yml. The test requires that all metadata steps use flavor latest=false and contain no `type=raw,value=latest`. It also requires the Validate image tags step to run before the first push, check-latest to have only contents: read permissions and no concurrency, and promote-latest to have needs, if, concurrency and exactly three imagetools create writes that follow a single latest-release check.
Symptom: Not applicable (this is a test convention). Edits that reorder steps or rename them break the test even when the workflow is valid.
Constraints: The test checks text patterns in the run scripts, so reformatting a command (for example, changing line continuations or the flag order) breaks it. The repo pre-commit hooks check-github-workflows and check-actions also validate this workflow file.
applies: Edits to .github/workflows/push-images.yml or its structural test.
says: Automated workflow validation tests fail after changing the container publishing pipeline.
Run local unit tests to verify changes to the container release workflow.
Pipeline structural tests fail when reordering release steps or formatting script commands.
Changes to image publish steps cause regression test failures in release verification.
search: The structural test test_floating_image_tags_are_promoted_after_versioned_images_are_published in tests/test_push_images_workflow.py parses .github/workflows/push-images.yml with yaml.safe_load to enforce job order, step indexes, permissions, and concurrency. Edits to the workflow must be verified using UV_FROZEN=1 uv run pytest tests/test_push_images_workflow.py and keep metadata steps on latest=false without type=raw,value=latest. It requires check-latest to have contents: read permissions and no concurrency, promote-latest to have three imagetools create writes following a latest-release check, and repo pre-commit hooks check-github-workflows and check-actions to pass.
